messages:
anya: Follow-up from postmortem for last night's streaming degradation. Short summary: client reconnect spikes + aggressive keepalives -> KV cache thrash -> timeouts and partial chunks. We need discrete owners for: 1) runtime heartbeat policy, 2) client SDK backoff + circuit breaker, 3) routing soft-fallbacks + alerts.
keith: I can take runtime heartbeat. Plan: increase idle keepalive to 15s, add 20% jitter, and treat 3 missed heartbeats as disconnect. Will canary to staging and compare partial_chunk_rate. ETA: Wed EOD.
li: I'll own SDK/backoff. Proposal: exponential backoff with capped jitter, max_attempts=6, and client-side circuit-breaker when observed partial_rate > 5% over 60s. Add opt-in header for graceful-downgrade to non-streaming path. ETA: Tue morning for PR.
ops-bot: Created INF-5402: "Streaming surge thresholds + fallback runbook" https://redwood/INF-5402
oncall-bot: Canary deploy scheduled: heartbeat config to staging at 3126003000 UTC.
anya: Ops/SRE to own routing fallback rules and alerts (composite alert on partial_response_rate + queue growth). Need runbook and escalation to SRE lead if partial_rate > 3% for 5 minutes. ETA for runbook: Fri EOD.
keith: Runtime snippet I'll push:
```
keepalive_interval=15s
keepalive_jitter=0.2
max_missed=3
prefetch_cache_ttl=30s
```
Adding metric: missed_heartbeats_per_session and partial_chunk_count.
li: SDK will remain backward compatible; header opt-in. I'll add integration tests for header negotiation and fallback behavior, and a load test scenario to infra-perf harness to reproduce rapid short reconnects.
anya: I've updated the postmortem doc and checklist (https://redwood/incident/3120043210/postmortem) and created a weekly 30-min sync for observation. Owners: Keith (runtime Wed EOD), Li (SDK Tue AM), Ops (runbook Fri EOD). Observation window: 4 weeks; rollback gate if partial_response_rate > 3% sustained.
keith: Note: runtime will accept both old and new keepalive headers so no forced client upgrade.
li: Also adding client-side fallback: when circuit-breaker trips, use non-stream endpoint for next N requests and backoff. Tests + PR linked to INF-5402.
anya: Closing: priority is to close observability gap for partial-response traces so we can correlate truncated streams to client/network events. Please link PRs and test results in INF-5402 before Tue sync. Thanks all. :wave:
